```{r}
# packages
library(tidyverse)     # ecosystem of data science packages
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
json1 <- '[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]'

r1 <- fromJSON(json1)
r1

```

```{r}
json2 <- '[true, true, false]'

r2 <- fromJSON(json2)
r2
```

```{r}
json3 <- '{"name": "Leia", "gender": "female", "height": 1.6, "force": true}'

fromJSON(json3)
```

```{r}
json4 <- '{
  "name": ["Leia", "Luke", "Han"],
  "gender": ["female", "male", "male"],
  "height": [1.6, 1.7, 1.8],
  "force": [true, true, false]
}'

fromJSON(json4)
```

```{r}
json4 <- fromJSON('{
  "name": ["Leia", "Luke", "Han"],
  "gender": ["female", "male", "male"],
  "height": [1.6, 1.7, 1.8],
  "force": [true, true, false]
}')

as.data.frame(json4)
```

```{r}
json5 <- '[
  {"name": "Leia", "gender": "female", "height": 1.6, "force": true},
  {"name": "Luke", "gender": "male", "height": 1.7, "force": true},
  {"name": "Han", "gender": "male", "height": 1.8, "force": false}
]'

fromJSON(json5)
```

```{r}
leia_lst <- list(
  "name" = "Leia", 
  "gender" = "female", 
  "height" = 1.50, 
  "force" = TRUE)

toJSON(leia_lst)
```

```{r}
leia_lst <- list(
  "name" = "Leia", 
  "gender" = "female", 
  "height" = 1.50, 
  "force" = TRUE)

toJSON(leia_lst, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
```

# Web Basics\

We’ll give you a crash introduction to HTTP so you can be prepared to work with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).\

Web made of Clients and Servers\
HTTP basics\
HTTP requests and responses\

- You access websites using software called a Web browser (e.g. Chrome, Firefox, etc).\
- The browser in your computer is the Client that requests a variety of resources.\
- The client’s request is sent to Web Servers which send responses back to the client.\
- The way Client and Server dialogue between each other is by following a formal protocol of communication.\
